what_this_is: The Workshop row for the tool in tools/show-my-automations-on-the-signed-in-page-what-sets: what it does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: List my automations
payload.job: Show everything my account does by itself on the signed-in page: each trigger, schedule and kept-running program with what sets it off in plain words, what it does, whether it is on, its last run and a switch, each workflow with the words of the conditions it fires on, and one of them opened as a when-then graph with the input of what it runs
payload.description: Give wakes (the rows wake:list answers), optionally recipes (my workflow rows; fields kept as JSON text are read back), tools (descriptors of the tools the wakes run: id, label, input_schema) and open (an id the list gave). Returns automations (id, open_id, kind trigger|schedule|running, name, when, does, starts, enabled, state, red, last_run_at, last_problem, switch), workflows (workflow_id, label, job, steps, fires_when words, enabled) and counts of red, on and off; with open, that one automation or workflow: says, does, then, input_schema, last_run and graph {steps, edges}. Reads only; the switch is the engine's wake:switch.

wakes.description: The rows wake:list answers: [{tool, id, on, budget, switched_on, mark}]

recipes.description: My workflow rows (the list workflow_recipes): id, label, job, steps, fires_when

tools.description: Descriptors of the tools the wakes run: [{id, label, input_schema}]

open.description: An id the list gave (automations[].id or open_id, or a workflow_id): answer that one

provenance.source: the old repository's src/work-workflows.mjs (commit b6ae0ebf81), the read model of the Automations screens, read now from the engine's wake:list rows and the person's workflow rows instead of the old rules store
